name: The Adventuring Party
description: A band of adventurers gathers at the tavern — each a different race, wielding a different weapon. Work out who's who.
clues: Elf, Gnome, and Half-Orc go with Dagger, Quarterstaff, and Warhammer, in some order.
Either Warhammer goes with Halfling or Quarterstaff goes with Thorne.
Between Lyra and Thorne, one goes with Gnome and the other with Crossbow.
If Lyra does not go with Gnome, then Crossbow goes with Dragonborn.
Either Half-Orc goes with Fenwick or Halfling goes with Warhammer.
Either Orin goes with Halfling, or Thorne goes with Gnome — but not both.
Either Fenwick goes with Dagger, or Dragonborn goes with Crossbow — but not both.

hints.text: Suppose Dragonborn went with Dagger — following the clues from there hits a contradiction, so it doesn't.
chain: Start by assuming Dragonborn goes with Dagger.
Dagger goes with Dragonborn, so Elf can't go with Dagger.
Dagger goes with Dragonborn, so Gnome can't go with Dagger.
Dagger goes with Dragonborn, so Half-Orc can't go with Dagger.
…but now the clue “Elf, Gnome, and Half-Orc go with Dagger, Quarterstaff, and Warhammer, in some order” can no longer hold — a contradiction.
So Dragonborn does not go with Dagger.
